searchText: How do they contradict? Will 8037 update follow? Idea is to have same bahaviour as in EIP-8037 But we do need to talk about your proposal on create, https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/11858 I see Maria left comment [here](https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/11858#pullrequestreview-4633976676) Basically, 8037 defined `intrinsic_state_gas` which after your changes to 2780 should not exist any more... At least this is my understanding. I see, i think this part could maybe be removed from EIP-8037 as it is redefined in EIP-2780. I think we should update 8037 once we merge 2780 I can propose the edit, <@425274498732916736> btw <@968526635735326741>, I can resync my PR to 8037 after the 2780 one lands. I would rather we close you PR today so that all the design decision are done The fixes to 8037 can come after
